newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPSM adjusts to gains in other banks.
newsitem.headline: BPSM adjusts to gains in other banks.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Pinto e Sotto Mayor rose 4.69 percent to 1,340 escudos, swept along with the euphoria of the market, as it caught up with the excellent performance of local banking stocks recently, dealers said.
"Sotto is benefiting from the positive mood in the market and catching up with other banking stocks," said a dealer who asked not to be identified.
Another dealer said: "The stock will probably not rise beyond the day's high as there are signs that the trend could reverse."
Sotto shares stood at 1,340 escudos, up 60, in volume of 766,589 shares at 1207 GMT.
